name: Skyhook Anchor
pitch: The ground station of a space elevator, bolted to a mesa over a 2 km drop: every gust of wind is a weapon, and the swarm has never learned to hold on.

theme.floor: Brushed steel deck plates #8a9299 with yellow-black edge stripes on every platform lip; pits are open sky
theme.walls: Anchor housings and cable clamps as tall blocks #5c646c with cyan running lights #4fd2ff along the top edge
theme.lighting: Low sun key light warm white #ffe9c7, intensity 1.3, 25 deg from the west (long shadows across the gaps); ambient sky blue #8fb3d9 at 0.5; a cyan point light #4fd2ff at 2.0 under each anchor block
theme.fog: Below the deck only: a cloud sea #dfe8f2 at -8 m with height fog, so pits read as a fall into cloud; above deck clear to 70 m
theme.signature_detail: The elevator tether: a 1.2 m wide dark cylinder rising from the central anchor block straight out of the top of the camera, with a climber car (cargo crate model, 2x) sliding up it every 40 s. Cloud particles drift past below the platform edges
theme.audio: High wind bed with gust swells, cable hum (low drone that pitches up during a gust), distant climber clank; enemies falling into the void scream and fade (Doppler pitch-down)

signature: Positioning is your best gun. Every 12 s a gust shoves everything 4 m/s one way; you can dash through it or hide in a block's wind shadow, the swarm cannot. Fight with the void downwind of the pack and a single gust clears the screen (full biomass for every fall). Crumbling walkways mean every route you take closes behind you, which also drops whatever was chasing you, and jump pads are the only routes that never break. Leapers are the counter-threat: they pounce across 3-cell gaps, so the safe island is never safe for long.

floors.events: Teach. The first gust fires 8 s in with a big HUD arrow and the hint 'GUSTS PUSH THE SWARM. STAND BEHIND BLOCKS.' Wave 2 comes up the north bridges in a single column, timed so a gust lands as they cross (scripted 'first void kill' moment, 10+ Drones off the edge). Wave 3 Leapers pounce the pit belts. The crumbling walkways crack under the hero's feet the first time with a slow-motion 0.3 s beat.

Twist. Each clamp terminal (R) is on a different island. Clamp 1 (north-west) is only reachable by jump pad from the central island; clamp 2 (north-east) by a crumbling walkway that falls behind you; clamp 3 (south-east) by the long south walkway. Each clamp completed swings the wind round 90 degrees (HUD compass) and fires a gust immediately. Weavers string webs across the walkways (a webbed walkway is a trap: stopped on a crumbling cell). Lancers on the far islands shoot across the void: no cover but anchor blocks.

floors.params: climber cart along the rail spine
floors.events: Test. The cargo cart rides a rail that crosses the void on a 1-cell bridge with no railings. Gusts push enemies off the bridge but also push the hero: stand downwind of the cart. Carapace charges along the bridge can be sidestepped so they fly off the end. At 50% track, the Gale Ravager (mini-boss) lands on the east deck and charges the cart.

Climax. The upload ring jumps between four corner islands and the central spine every 10 s. The crumbling walkways are the fast way to the next ring and fall after use; the hazard-striped bridges are slow but permanent; one jump pad pair links the diagonal. Gusts every 9 s on this floor (storm front). At 20 s the climber car breaks loose high above and three STRIKE containers fall on the spine (red circles, leave crates as new wind shadows).

The Tether Crown: an outer ring around the elevator shaft, joined to the inner ring by four crumbling spokes and one jump pad pair. Cloudbreaker pounces between rings; its landings crack spokes. Gusts every 12 s, and in phase 3 the boss calls them.

miniboss.name: Gale Ravager (Ravager Prime variant, enemies doc 3.2)
miniboss.body: HP 60, front 10%. Keeps the Triple Charge, but railings (r) break when it hits them instead of stunning it, opening that edge to the void. If a gust fires while it is stunned within 2 m of an open edge, it is blown over the lip and hangs on for 4 s ('LEDGE' state: takes x2 damage and cannot act); if it is still above 30% HP it climbs back, otherwise it falls and dies. Shell Shards every 12 s. At 40% it calls 2 Carapace that charge along the cart rail. Counterplay: stand with an open edge behind you, sidestep the third charge, and wait for the gust arrow.
miniboss.look: Carapace placeholder at 1.6x, slate grey #3a4048 with the orange emissive front, three Lancer spikes on its back, plus pale cyan streak particles trailing off its shell (wind-blasted).

boss.name: Cloudbreaker
boss.body: A giant alpha Leaper that has lived on the tether, HP 280. Phase 1 (100-60%): Sky Pounce: picks a landing spot on the hero's ring (red arrow plus a 3 m red landing circle, 1.2 s), lands for 25 damage and a 4 m shove, and any crumbling cell under the circle falls. Between pounces it stalks at 0.6x and swipes (cone, 0.7 s, 18 damage). Phase 2 (60-30%): Cable Snap: it tears a tether cable; a yellow line telegraph crosses the arena (1.0 s) and a whipping cable sweeps along it (30 damage, shoves enemies into pits too). Lays 2 egg-less Leaper pups per pounce. Phase 3 (30-0%): Stormcaller: it roars before every gust, gusts every 7 s and the boss chooses the direction, always toward the nearest pit from the hero; it pounces only across pits. Counterplay: the boss can't be killed by falling, but a gust or a jump pad landing shove that catches it within 1 m of a pit lip makes it hang on (LEDGE, 4 s, x2 damage, once per 15 s). Take the jump pad when it commits to a pounce on your ring and it lands on nothing but crumbling cells.
boss.look: Leaper model at 3.0x, storm grey #6f7a86 with white streak tint on the back and cyan emissive eyes #4fd2ff; the cable is a stretched cylinder (tether material) with the tracer trail.

modifiers: Jet Stream: gusts every 7 s and 5 m/s.
Rotten Decking: every '.' cell next to a pit is a crumbling cell.
Pouncers: +50% Leapers, and Leapers pounce gaps up to 4 cells.
Ion Storm: lightning STRIKE every 9 s; anchor blocks act as lightning rods (strikes within 3 cells of a block hit the block instead).

rewards.first_clear: Adds the Decoy Hologram power-up to the drop pool with a twist here: decoys placed at a pit edge pull the swarm into the void. +20 Cores.
rewards.replay: The best biomass farm in Act III: void kills pay full biomass and gusts clear packs, so it levels cards fast. Star 3 needs a deliberate wind setup, a good Hard-tier challenge run.

stars.3: Beat Cloudbreaker after making it hang off a ledge three times.
stars.bonus: Kill 60 enemies with falls in one run (void kills count across all floors).

layout_notes.skyhook-a: Anchor Ring. North and south decks, two pit belts crossed by crumbling walkways and a railed central bridge, the anchor block in the middle as the wind shadow everyone fights over.
layout_notes.skyhook-b: Clamp Islands. Five islands: south-west start, central hub, north-west clamp by jump pad only, north-east clamp by a crumbling walkway, south-east clamp by the long crumbling bridge and a railed descent from the north-east.
layout_notes.skyhook-c: Cargo Spine. The cart rail snakes from the west deck across a 1-cell bridge over the central chasm to the east deck. A jump pad pair at the south crosses back.
layout_notes.skyhook-d: Shear Deck. Four corner islands and a central spine; each island has a crumbling fast bridge and a striped permanent one. One jump pad pair links south-west to north-east.
layout_notes.skyhook-boss: Tether Crown. Outer ring, crumbling spokes, inner ring around the open tether shaft in the centre; one jump pad pair from the north outer ring to the inner ring.

name: Wreck of the Valiant
pitch: A fleet carrier that fell out of orbit and broke its back on the plateau, still burning, still tilting, its guns still looking for targets.

theme.floor: Gunmetal deck plating #4a4f55 with worn white deck markings and scorch decals; carpeted crew areas #5b2f2f (dark wine, never telegraph red)
theme.walls: Bulkheads and fallen fighters as tall blocks #3b4047 with amber emergency strip lights #ffb347 along the base; hull breaches show sky
theme.lighting: Key light dim daylight #d8dde6, intensity 0.8, 60 deg from the north through hull breaches; amber emergency point lights #ffb347 at 1.6 every 6 m; fire cells add flicker. Ambient #4d5560 at 0.35
theme.fog: Smoke #3a3a3f, exponential, density 0.025; thicker at the downhill end
theme.signature_detail: The whole scene rolled 4 degrees (DRIFT): loose crates creak downhill, sparks rain from torn cables, and a huge ship's nameplate 'VALIANT' (white block letters on a bulkhead) hangs at an angle in every layout
theme.audio: Groaning hull metal, alarm klaxon looping far away, fire crackle, the ship's PA repeating 'ABANDON SHIP' in a calm synthetic voice

signature: The deck slopes, so everything drifts downhill at 1.2 m/s: you, the swarm, and the barrels. Fighting uphill is slow and safe, fighting downhill is fast and dangerous, and a barrel kicked loose at the top rolls into the pack below and explodes. Fires spread across carpets and crates and can be used to wall off a flank. Point-defence turrets still work: capture one and the swarm turns on it, which is a breather you have to place well. The finale is a reactor fire chasing you down the engine spine.

floors.events: Teach. Hangar deck tilted east. Barrels line the uphill west wall: the first time the hero shoots near one, the hint 'BARRELS ROLL DOWNHILL' shows and it bowls into wave 1. Two turrets are live. Wave 3 spawns uphill (Bloaters roll faster downhill, 0.7x).

Twist. Crew compartments: each recorder ($) sits in a different room. Fires (f) spread through the compartments over the floor (SPREAD fire on carpet), so the order you loot them matters: the burning rooms first. Each pickup's ambush arrives through the downhill doorway. Carapace charges downhill are 30% faster and cannot stop at the doorway: bait them into bulkheads.

Test. Protect the fire-control core (G) on its railed dais while six point-defence turrets ring the deck. Captured turrets take the heat off the core (enemies near a live turret attack it 50% of the time), so the floor is about rotating captures. Deck Crusher (mini-boss) arrives at 30 s from uphill and charges the core.

floors.params: reactor fire front from the west
floors.events: Climax. The reactor fire FRONT starts at the west wall and sweeps east at 1.3 m/s; the deck now tilts east as well (it pushes you toward the lift, so the danger is overrunning into packs). Three bulkhead terminals (R) pause it 4 s each. Enemies spawn ahead from the east. Barrels in the corridor explode when the front reaches them: stay ahead of the chain.
The bridge. The boss stands on the raised command deck behind railings. Four bridge turrets: whoever captures them last owns them (in phase 3 the boss captures them too).

miniboss.name: Deck Crusher (Juggernaut Carapace, elite rules)
miniboss.body: HP 55, front 15%, regenerating front armour 2 s after a stun. Its charge lane follows the slope: 35% faster downhill, 30% slower uphill, and a downhill charge that hits a bulkhead stuns for 4 s (2.5 s otherwise). Charges leave a shockwave line (8 damage) and set fire to any crate they break. Targets the DEFEND core first. Counterplay: stand downhill of it with a block at your back and dodge; a captured turret pulls it away from the core.
miniboss.look: Carapace placeholder at 1.8x, gunmetal #4a4f55 with the ship's white deck markings as a stripe decal and an amber emissive front #ffb347.

boss.name: Fallen Vanguard
boss.body: The Valiant's last marine, infested: a hero-scale gunner, HP 260. Phase 1 (100-65%): Suppression: walks the command deck firing minigun bursts in a 40 deg red cone (0.8 s telegraph, 3 s burst, 6 damage per hit); breaks off to toss a barrel downhill every 10 s. Phase 2 (65-35%): Barrage, the hero's own skill turned on you: plants (stomp ring), 3 s overdrive cone with knockback, and the knockback plus the drift pushes you downhill into the fire cells at the bottom of the bridge. Break line of sight behind crates or dash across the cone. Phase 3 (35-0%): Hive Override: the boss captures every turret within 10 m (they go red and fire at you) and sets fire to the upper bridge; recapturing a turret also makes it fire at the boss (x3 damage, the only way to strip his 50% damage reduction in this phase). Counterplay throughout: barrels rolled from the uphill wall deal triple damage to him; attack from the side of the cone, never from below.
boss.look: The Iron Vanguard hero model at 1.6x, armour tinted infested purple #5a2a6e with creep veins (the creep emissive #b04dff) on the shoulders, red-violet visor; minigun as built, its muzzle flash recoloured violet.

modifiers: Hard Tilt: drift 2.0 m/s and barrels respawn at the top wall every 20 s.
Inferno: every floor starts with twice the fire cells and fire spreads 30% faster.
Rogue Defences: unowned turrets fire at the hero after 10 s idle until captured.
Armoured Boarders: 20% of spawns are Armoured (enemies doc modifier).

rewards.first_clear: Adds Endless Mag to the drop pool and unlocks the 'Valiant Survivor' banner. +20 Cores.
rewards.replay: Thermal Projector blueprint zone (upgrade doc). The boss mirrors the Vanguard's Barrage, so it is also the zone players replay to learn the Vanguard's skill.

stars.3: Finish the OUTRUN floor without the fire front ever touching you, and win the boss fight after recapturing every turret.
stars.bonus: Kill 30 enemies with rolling barrels in one run.

layout_notes.valiant-a: Hangar Deck. Drift east. Parked fighters as blocks, barrels on the uphill west wall, two point-defence turrets.
layout_notes.valiant-b: Crew Compartments. A grid of rooms with bulkheads and doorways, one recorder per room, the lift in the middle-east room.
layout_notes.valiant-c: Point-Defence Deck. A railed dais around the fire-control core, six turrets around the deck, crates as charge bait.
layout_notes.valiant-d: Engine Spine. A long west-to-east corridor broken by engine blocks, three bulkhead terminals and the lift at the east end.
layout_notes.valiant-boss: The Bridge. Raised command deck at the north behind railings (entry in the middle), four turrets, fire at the low south end.

name: Halvorsen Reactor
pitch: The colony's fusion plant, ninety seconds from going critical and full of things that like the heat: turn the valves, save the pumps, scram the core and get out.

theme.floor: Pale concrete #b8b5ad with yellow-black hazard bands around every radiation zone; irradiated cells glow #c8ff3a
theme.walls: Containment blocks #9aa0a6 with lead-grey #5f6670 shielding and blue coolant pipes (cylinders #3f7fbf) running along the tops
theme.lighting: Key light clinical white #f2f6ff, intensity 1.0, 70 deg nearly overhead; Cherenkov blue point lights #3fa9ff at 2.5 around the core; ambient #7f8a92 at 0.4. The key light shifts toward amber #ffcf7a as each floor's meltdown clock advances
theme.fog: Thin steam haze #e6eef2, linear 30-70 m; by floor 4 it turns amber #d9b56a
theme.signature_detail: A big analogue reactor clock on the HUD frame ('CORE TEMP') that climbs across the whole run: each floor starts hotter, alarms get faster, and the light shifts. The central reactor block hums with a blue glow that pulses with the vent rhythm
theme.audio: Geiger clicks tied to the RAD meter, reactor hum, two-tone siren that speeds up per floor, pipes banging when vents fire, a calm voice: 'Core temperature: critical in... '

signature: Act III's exam. Radiation zones are the shortest routes and the swarm grows stronger (+20% damage) standing in them, so you dart through and never fight inside. Steam vents on a two-group rhythm are kill columns if you lure the pack through on the warning beat. Valve and pump terminals are the floor's real objectives and enemies know it: every interaction is a stand-your-ground moment while auto-fire carries you. The zone ends in a scram (plant charges on the control rods, run) and a fight with a thing that eats radiation.

floors.events: Teach. Turbine hall full of radiation patches and vents. Each valve (R) purges the radiation in its quarter of the room (q cells fade out over 3 s) and fires every vent at once as a steam burst that kills anything in it. Valve 2 sits inside a radiation patch: the RAD meter tutorial.

Twist. The spent-fuel pool: one nest sits on the cooling pool, two in irradiated corners. Enemies spawned from those nests start irradiated (glowing, +20% damage, leave a 1-cell q trail for 4 s). Menders tether the nests. The vents here are tied to the pool and fire every 4 s.

Test. Keep the main coolant pump (G) alive for 60 s inside its railed pit. Two valve terminals (R) each vent the pump's steam for 6 s (cooldown 15 s): every vent on the floor erupts and the pump is immune for the eruption. The irradiated Gravid Bloater (mini-boss) arrives at 25 s and walks straight for the pump.

floors.params: 4 control-rod charges, then 25 s to the lift
floors.events: Climax. Scram the core: plant charges on the four control rods (!), three of them inside radiation (plant time 3 s, which costs about 40% RAD each). On the last plant the 25 s countdown starts and the vents switch to 'overpressure' (eruptions every 3 s). Weavers web the route to the lift during the countdown.
The core chamber: the boss walks a ring of radiation around the reactor, four valves (R) at the corners, vents at the cardinal points. Phase 3 brings a reactor fire FRONT.

miniboss.name: Hot Gravid (Gravid Bloater mini-boss, irradiated)
miniboss.body: HP 60, no phase 2 (enemies doc 3.1). Births 4 irradiated Drones every 5 s (glowing, +20% damage). Its Pus Slam leaves a 4 m radiation pool (q for 8 s) instead of pus, and it heads for the pump. Steam vents deal it triple damage and pop its births. Counterplay: kite it across an erupting vent column, and use the valve vent to protect the pump when it arrives.
miniboss.look: Bloater at 2.0x with the pus material recoloured sickly yellow-green #c8ff3a and a yellow point light inside it.

boss.name: Core Behemoth
boss.body: A Carapace that crawled into the reactor and grew. HP 320, front takes 15%. Phase 1 (100-65%): Fallout Walk: it walks the radiation ring and every cell it touches becomes q for 10 s; charges along a yellow lane (1.0 s) that ends in a radiation splash. Steam vents erupting under it crack its shell (front armour gone for 5 s and it staggers 1 s). Phase 2 (65-35%): Critical: it vents its back: three radiation rings (red, 1.2 s) pulse outward; it absorbs radiation, so every q cell within 3 m heals it 1 HP/s. The four valves (R) purge one quarter of the arena each (cooldown 20 s): purge the ring under it to stop the heal. Phase 3 (35-0%): Meltdown: a reactor fire FRONT sweeps from the north at 1.0 m/s and stops at the reactor block, cutting the arena in half; completing a valve pauses it 4 s. The boss enrages (speed 0.8x, charges every 4 s). Counterplay: lure charges into the reactor block (stun 3 s, back exposed), fight it on the vents, and turn valves in the gaps.
boss.look: Carapace placeholder at 3.0x, lead grey #5f6670 shell with a glowing yellow-green core stripe #c8ff3a down the back and blue Cherenkov point light under its belly.

modifiers: Hot Core: radiation fills 30% faster and decays 30% slower.
Overpressure: all vents cycle in 4 s instead of 6 s.
Containment Breach: every Drone leaves a 1-cell q trail for 3 s.
Blackout: the plant's lights fail; DARKNESS rules with valves acting as light pylons once turned.

rewards.first_clear: Unlocks the 'Scram' title and adds the Stasis Field power-up to the drop pool. +30 Cores.
rewards.replay: Act III finale and the Mk IV gate (upgrade doc). Thermal Projector blueprint zone. Hard tier here is the doorway to Act IV farming.

stars.3: Kill the Core Behemoth while it stands in a steam eruption (killing blow inside a vent).
stars.bonus: Clear without the RAD meter ever reaching 100%.

layout_notes.halvorsen-a: Turbine Hall. Radiation patches in three quarters, a vent grid, the three valves in the north-west, east and south-west.
layout_notes.halvorsen-b: Spent Fuel Pool. The cooling pool (blue cells) at the north with a nest on it, irradiated corners holding the other two nests, Spore Pods at the pool edge.
layout_notes.halvorsen-c: Coolant Pumps. The pump on a railed dais in the middle, valves north and south, vents in a ring, radiation at the corners.
layout_notes.halvorsen-d: Core Scram. The reactor block at the north with four control rods around it, three inside radiation; the lift in the north-east corner.
layout_notes.halvorsen-boss: Core Chamber. Reactor block in the centre, radiation ring around it, vents at the cardinal points, valves in the four corners.

name: The Burrows
pitch: Below the reactor the swarm has dug a city: pitch-black tunnels, egg-lined walls that breathe, and things that hunt by sound.

theme.floor: Packed earth #3b2f27 with root-like creep veins #2a0f33 and faint emissive vein glow #b04dff near nests
theme.walls: Rock blocks #4a3d33 with wet highlights; hive walls with the creep material and a breathing scale
theme.lighting: DARKNESS: directional #9fb0c8 at 8% from directly above (a shaft of grey), ambient #1a1420 at 10%; hero light cool white 5.5 m; pylons white #f0f6ff at 7 m; nest glow #b04dff point lights at 1.2
theme.signature_detail: Every enemy shows two red eye glints in the dark; the camera picks up dust falling from the ceiling after each Burrower eruption, and lit pylons leave a permanent pool of light that slowly turns the creep near it grey (dead)
theme.audio: Near silence: dripping water, the hero's footsteps, distant chittering that pans with off-screen packs; eggs hiss before hatching; a low heartbeat that speeds up when a Stalker is within 10 m

signature: Act IV opens with a horror floor. You only see and shoot what is lit, so flares and pylons are your ammunition as much as bullets are: light a pylon and that cavern is yours. The tunnels are full of egg clusters you can't see until your light touches them, hive walls that can be shot open for a shortcut (and grow back), and nests that keep the dark full. Burrowers erupt from the floor, Stalkers come cloaked from behind and Ticks swarm out of egg fields, so the dash is always on your thumb.

floors.events: Teach. The warren. Two pylons and two flare caches on the main route. The first nest is visible from the start (glow), the other two are behind hive walls. Each nest killed lights its chamber (nest glow turns into a 6 m white light for the rest of the floor).

Twist. A long winding tunnel the colony miners lit with a lamp line. Each relay (R) relights one third of the tunnel permanently (lit cells: enemies there are exposed, +20% damage). Between relays, egg clusters along the walls hatch as you pass. Relay 2 is in the middle of a Stalker pair's patrol: the heartbeat audio starts before you see them.

Test. The Tunnel Matron (mini-boss) flees through the hive walls (she passes them; they open for her and close behind) toward the far side, summoning Burrower escorts every 10 s. Kill her in 60 s for the bonus. Flares stuck on her (a flare thrown within 1 m sticks) keep her visible.

Climax: the Deep Dark. Only two pylons and one flare cache. Every egg on the floor hatches at 30 s and again at 60 s (eggs regrow on creep cells). At 45 s the hero's own light flickers out for 6 s ('LIGHT FAILURE'): only flares and pylons see.
The Gloom Pit: four pylons in the corners, a central dark ring (d cells stay unlit even with pylons), hive walls as cover.

miniboss.name: Tunnel Matron (ASSASSINATE target, Grand Mender elite rules)
miniboss.body: HP 4x a Grand Mender (about 60), gold outline. Flees at 1.1x, passes through hive walls, and heals every nest and egg she passes (1 HP/s, 6 m). Every 10 s she summons 2 Burrowers that surface between her and the hero. In light she is 'exposed' (+20% damage taken); in the dark only her eye glints and the green tether to her nearest escort show. Counterplay: light the pylon on her route, stick a flare on her, and shoot the hive wall ahead of her (she has to wait 1 s for it to regrow).
miniboss.look: Mender placeholder (Drone 1.1x, mint) at 2.2x, tinted pale bone #d8cbb8 with a swollen green emissive sac and a gold rim; trails a faint white mist.

boss.name: The Gloom
boss.body: A Stalker grown to the size of a truck. HP 300. Phase 1 (100-65%): Hunt in the Dark: it stays cloaked and circles at 1.3x; it can only be targeted while inside light (pylons, flares, the hero's light) and takes +20% in pylon light. It strikes from behind: de-cloak hiss and a white blade arc (0.6 s), 28 damage. Phase 2 (65-35%): Lights Out: every 15 s it smashes the nearest lit pylon (a yellow line from it to the pylon, 1.5 s, interrupted by 6 RH of damage); the hero must relight pylons (1.5 s stand) under pressure. It digs through hive walls (they explode outward, 10 damage). Phase 3 (35-0%): Many Eyes: it splits into itself plus two shadow decoys (Shade Stalker rule), all three cloaked; only the real one has eye glints, and the eggs on the floor hatch all at once. Counterplay: stand in a lit pylon and let it come to you; a flare thrown on its de-cloak sticks and reveals it for 8 s; area damage reveals all three in phase 3.
boss.look: Leaper model at 2.8x, near-black #141218 with the Stalker's cyan emissive slit #4fd2ff, cloaked = 12% alpha with the scrolling noise; decoys use the same at 8% alpha with no eye glints.

modifiers: Pitch Black: no pylons on the first floor of each layout and flares start at 2.
Ambush Burrows: +60% Burrowers and they surface twice per dig.
Egg Carpet: every creep cell grows an egg cluster after 20 s.
Stalker Pack: Stalkers come in pairs (the second de-cloaks 1 s after the first).

rewards.first_clear: Adds a fourth flare charge for every dark floor in the game and unlocks the 'Lamplighter' banner. +30 Cores.
rewards.replay: Thermal Projector blueprint zone, and the biomass-dense egg fields make it the best Act IV card-leveling farm. Star 3 asks for full control of light.

stars.3: Light every pylon on every floor, and kill the Tunnel Matron within 60 s.
stars.bonus: Destroy 40 egg clusters before they hatch in one run.

layout_notes.burrows-a: Warren. Rock tunnels around three nest chambers, two pylons, two flare caches, hive walls hiding shortcuts.
layout_notes.burrows-b: Lamp Line. One long switchback tunnel from the north-west to the south-east, relays at each third, egg clusters along the walls.
layout_notes.burrows-c: Matron's Run. A cavern crossed by hive walls; the Matron starts north and flees south-east through the walls.
layout_notes.burrows-d: The Deep Dark. A wide cavern with egg fields everywhere, two pylons, one flare cache, dark pockets.
layout_notes.burrows-boss: Gloom Pit. Four pylons in the corners, a dark ring in the middle, hive walls and rock pillars as cover.
